io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.implementation.tasks.armor

Class AbstractArmorTask

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.implementation.tasks.armor.AbstractArmorTask
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Runnable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    RadiationTask, RainbowArmorTask, SlimefunArmorTask, SolarHelmetTask

    public abstract class AbstractArmorTask
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.lang.Runnable
    This is a base class for any ArmorTask, it checks every online player and handles any armor functionality.

    SlimefunArmorTask, RainbowArmorTask
